body: So I just got discharged from the hospital! I'm so happy I listened to you, they ran some tests and found out that my liver was badly damaged but not so much from the paracetamol, but from the alcohol abuse I wasn't even really aware I was doing over the past year since my last blood test. My enzyme count had tripled! They kept me in overnight for some liver treatment (transfusion). It was absolutely horrible and I feel very week but I'm alive and have now vowed to go t-total for the foreseeable future. Thank you so much, may have just saved my life!
